definition: the amount of something that people use or eat
sentence: Fuel {consumption} drops when you drive slowly.
translation: Расход топлива падает, когда едешь медленно.

definition: dishonest behavior by people in power, such as taking money for favors
sentence: The mayor was arrested for {corruption} after taking bribes.
translation: Мэра арестовали за коррупцию после получения взяток.

definition: a soft white material from a plant, used to make cloth and thread
sentence: The shirt is made of pure {cotton}.
translation: Рубашка сделана из чистого хлопка.

definition: extremely beautiful or pleasant
sentence: What a {gorgeous} day for a walk on the beach!
translation: Какой чудесный день для прогулки по пляжу!

definition: feeling thankful for something someone did for you
sentence: I'm so {grateful} you drove me to the airport.
translation: Я так благодарна, что ты отвёз меня в аэропорт.

definition: animal skin treated and used to make shoes, bags and jackets
sentence: The sofa is covered in brown {leather}.
translation: Диван обтянут коричневой кожей.

definition: used to say what is the right thing to do or what is likely
sentence: You {ought} to see a doctor about that cough.
translation: Тебе стоит показаться врачу с этим кашлем.

definition: a game in which players hit a ball over a net with rackets
sentence: She plays {tennis} every Saturday morning.
translation: Она играет в теннис каждую субботу утром.

definition: the number 12
sentence: There are {twelve} months in a year.
translation: В году двенадцать месяцев.

definition: a building where people go for medical treatment or advice
sentence: The {clinic} is open from eight until six.
translation: Клиника открыта с восьми до шести.

definition: liquid forced out of a container in very small drops
sentence: Use a {spray} to keep insects off the plants.
translation: Используй спрей, чтобы отпугивать насекомых от растений.

definition: a large natural hole in the side of a hill or under the ground
sentence: Bats live in the {cave} at the end of the valley.
translation: В пещере в конце долины живут летучие мыши.

definition: running side by side at the same distance apart, never meeting
sentence: The road runs {parallel} to the river for ten miles.
translation: Дорога десять миль идёт параллельно реке.

definition: to make someone annoyed because they cannot achieve what they want
sentence: Slow internet can {frustrate} even patient people.
translation: Медленный интернет может вывести из себя даже терпеливых людей.

definition: a ball of air or gas inside a liquid, or floating in the air
sentence: A {bubble} rose to the surface of the pond.
translation: Пузырь поднялся к поверхности пруда.

definition: a large female farm animal kept for its milk or meat
sentence: The {cow} stood in the field chewing grass.
translation: Корова стояла в поле и жевала траву.

definition: a love relationship, or a story about love
sentence: Their {romance} began on a train to Paris.
translation: Их роман начался в поезде до Парижа.

definition: a person who studies a subject in great detail, especially at a university
sentence: The {scholar} spent her life studying ancient Greek plays.
translation: Учёная всю жизнь изучала древнегреческие пьесы.

definition: the passage inside the neck that food and air go down
sentence: I have a sore {throat} and cannot sing today.
translation: У меня болит горло, и я не могу сегодня петь.

definition: the ability to make good decisions, or a decision made by a court
sentence: Choosing that road showed poor {judgment}.
translation: Выбор той дороги показал плохое суждение.

definition: a formal test of knowledge, or a careful look at something
sentence: The doctor gave him a full {examination} before the operation.
translation: Врач провёл полное обследование перед операцией.

definition: a person or company that does work for others under a contract, often building
sentence: The {contractor} promised to finish the roof by Friday.
translation: Подрядчик обещал закончить крышу к пятнице.

definition: the act of killing someone as a legal punishment, or of carrying out a plan
sentence: The {execution} of the prisoner was stopped at the last minute.
translation: Казнь заключённого остановили в последнюю минуту.

definition: a large building with many shops inside
sentence: The new {mall} has a cinema and fifty shops.
translation: В новом торговом центре есть кинотеатр и пятьдесят магазинов.

definition: formal discussion between people trying to reach an agreement
sentence: After weeks of {negotiation}, the workers accepted the offer.
translation: После нескольких недель переговоров рабочие приняли предложение.

definition: the act of putting a name or information on an official list
sentence: {Registration} for the course closes on Friday.
translation: Регистрация на курс закрывается в пятницу.

definition: to break a rule, law or agreement
sentence: The driver {violated} three rules in one minute.
translation: Водитель нарушил три правила за одну минуту.

definition: to put things into groups according to their type
sentence: Scientists {classify} whales as mammals, not fish.
translation: Учёные относят китов к млекопитающим, а не к рыбам.

definition: to copy data from your computer to the internet or a larger system
sentence: It took an hour to {upload} the video to the website.
translation: Загрузка видео на сайт заняла час.

definition: average in amount or degree, not extreme
sentence: The hotel charges {moderate} prices for the area.
translation: Отель берёт умеренные цены для этого района.

definition: a long gun that you hold against your shoulder to fire
sentence: The hunter carried a {rifle} over his shoulder.
translation: Охотник нёс винтовку на плече.

definition: a person whose job is to check that rules are followed
sentence: The health {inspector} closed the restaurant for a week.
translation: Санитарный инспектор закрыл ресторан на неделю.

definition: to be more than a certain number or limit
sentence: The repairs {exceeded} the price of the car itself.
translation: Ремонт обошёлся дороже самой машины.

definition: an illegal act, or something that upsets or insults people
sentence: Driving without a license is a serious {offense}.
translation: Вождение без прав — серьёзное правонарушение.

definition: to say or do something rude that upsets someone
sentence: He did not mean to {insult} her cooking.
translation: Он не хотел оскорбить её стряпню.

definition: the act of putting a plan or decision into action
sentence: The {implementation} of the new system took six months.
translation: Внедрение новой системы заняло шесть месяцев.

definition: a liquid or gas; a substance that flows
sentence: The doctor told him to drink plenty of {fluid}.
translation: Врач велел ему пить много жидкости.

definition: an official decision made by a judge or court
sentence: The court's {ruling} surprised both sides.
translation: Решение суда удивило обе стороны.

definition: a chart showing the days, weeks and months of a year
sentence: Mark the date of the party on the {calendar}.
translation: Отметь дату вечеринки в календаре.

definition: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow
sentence: Take one {pill} with water after breakfast.
translation: Прими одну таблетку с водой после завтрака.

definition: one of the two organs in the chest used for breathing
sentence: Smoking damages the {lung} tissue over time.
translation: Курение со временем повреждает ткань лёгких.

definition: a country controlled by another country, or a group of animals living together
sentence: India was a British {colony} until 1947.
translation: Индия была британской колонией до 1947 года.

definition: relating to farming
sentence: The {agricultural} show has prizes for the best cow and the biggest pumpkin.
translation: На сельскохозяйственной выставке есть призы за лучшую корову и самую большую тыкву.

definition: a slow, sad style of music that began among Black Americans
sentence: He plays the {blues} on an old guitar.
translation: Он играет блюз на старой гитаре.

definition: having a very pleasant taste or smell
sentence: The soup was {delicious}; can I have the recipe?
translation: Суп был очень вкусный, можно рецепт?

definition: relating to genes, the parts of cells passed from parents to children
sentence: The disease is {genetic}, so it runs in families.
translation: Болезнь генетическая, поэтому передаётся в семьях.

definition: happening immediately
sentence: The new song was an {instant} hit.
translation: Новая песня мгновенно стала хитом.

definition: very quickly
sentence: The fire spread {rapidly} through the dry forest.
translation: Огонь быстро распространился по сухому лесу.

definition: happening soon
sentence: The band announced dates for its {upcoming} tour.
translation: Группа объявила даты предстоящего тура.

definition: to take air into your body and let it out again
sentence: It was hard to {breathe} in the smoky room.
translation: В прокуренной комнате было трудно дышать.

definition: to interrupt someone, or to make them worried
sentence: Please do not {disturb} me while I am on the phone.
translation: Пожалуйста, не беспокой меня, пока я говорю по телефону.

definition: to discuss something to reach an agreement
sentence: I {negotiated} a lower rent with the landlord.
translation: Я договорился с хозяином о более низкой аренде.

definition: a list of things to be discussed at a meeting
sentence: The first item on the {agenda} is the budget.
translation: Первый пункт повестки дня — бюджет.

definition: a fault or problem that makes something less strong, or the state of being weak
sentence: His main {weakness} as a player is his speed.
translation: Его главная слабость как игрока — скорость.

definition: a player whose job is to stop the other team from scoring
sentence: The {defender} cleared the ball off the line.
translation: Защитник выбил мяч с линии ворот.

definition: a sweet, thick food made by cooking fruit with sugar
sentence: She spread strawberry {jam} on her toast.
translation: Она намазала клубничное варенье на тост.

definition: to cause something to be in a particular state, or to give or provide
sentence: The flood could {render} the bridge unsafe for weeks.
translation: Наводнение может сделать мост небезопасным на недели.

definition: to describe the main points of something without the details
sentence: Let me {outline} the plan before we discuss the details.
translation: Позвольте мне обрисовать план, прежде чем мы обсудим детали.

definition: a piece of information that helps you find the answer
sentence: I have no {clue} where I left my phone.
translation: Понятия не имею, где я оставил телефон.

definition: what happens or is used if nothing else is chosen
sentence: The {default} language of the app is English.
translation: Язык приложения по умолчанию — английский.

definition: a room where things are made or repaired, or a meeting for learning by doing
sentence: The teachers attended a {workshop} on using computers in class.
translation: Учителя посетили семинар по использованию компьютеров на уроках.

definition: a large sea fish with many pointed teeth that can attack people
sentence: A {shark} was seen near the beach, so swimming was banned.
translation: Рядом с пляжем заметили акулу, и купание запретили.

definition: a soft piece of clothing worn on the foot inside a shoe
sentence: I can only find one blue {sock}.
translation: Я нашёл только один синий носок.

definition: a measurement of length, width or height, or a part of a situation
sentence: Measure every {dimension} of the room before ordering the carpet.
translation: Измерь все размеры комнаты, прежде чем заказывать ковёр.

definition: the value of a company's shares, or of a house after the loan is paid
sentence: They used the {equity} in their house to pay for the extension.
translation: Они использовали свободную стоимость дома, чтобы оплатить пристройку.

definition: a long thick piece of wood or metal that holds up a roof
sentence: A wooden {beam} runs across the ceiling of the kitchen.
translation: Деревянная балка проходит через потолок кухни.

definition: a special right or advantage that only some people have
sentence: It's a {privilege} to work with people I actually like.
translation: Это привилегия — работать с людьми, которые мне по-настоящему нравятся.

definition: a child at school, or the black circle in the middle of the eye
sentence: Every {pupil} in the class passed the test.
translation: Каждый ученик в классе сдал тест.

definition: the way a person lives, including what they eat and do
sentence: A healthy {lifestyle} includes exercise and good sleep.
translation: Здоровый образ жизни включает физическую активность и хороший сон.

definition: violent behavior by a crowd of people in a public place
sentence: The {riot} started after the football match.
translation: Беспорядки начались после футбольного матча.

definition: a large round container with flat ends, used for liquids
sentence: The wine is kept in an oak {barrel} for two years.
translation: Вино выдерживают в дубовой бочке два года.

definition: one of the five parts at the end of the foot
sentence: I hurt my big {toe} on the edge of the bed.
translation: Я ушиб большой палец ноги о край кровати.

definition: to study something carefully in order to understand it
sentence: Scientists will {analyze} the water for signs of pollution.
translation: Учёные проанализируют воду на признаки загрязнения.

definition: a legal agreement to use a building or car for a period, for payment
sentence: The shop has a ten-year {lease} on the building.
translation: У магазина десятилетняя аренда здания.

definition: something you must do because of a law, promise or duty
sentence: Parents have an {obligation} to send their children to school.
translation: Родители обязаны отправлять детей в школу.

definition: a thick liquid served with food to give it more taste
sentence: The pasta came with a rich tomato {sauce}.
translation: Пасту подали с насыщенным томатным соусом.

definition: a sudden loud bursting with great force, as from a bomb
sentence: The {explosion} broke windows a mile away.
translation: Взрыв выбил окна за милю отсюда.

definition: an evil spirit
sentence: The story is about a {demon} that lives under the bridge.
translation: История о демоне, который живёт под мостом.

definition: to choose someone or something officially for a particular purpose
sentence: The council will {designate} the old mill as a historic site.
translation: Совет объявит старую мельницу историческим памятником.

definition: to make someone want to do something
sentence: Good teachers know how to {motivate} their students.
translation: Хорошие учителя умеют мотивировать учеников.

definition: a set of rules or ideas that support a plan or system
sentence: The new law provides a {framework} for protecting rivers.
translation: Новый закон создаёт основу для защиты рек.

definition: a flying insect with yellow and black stripes that makes honey
sentence: A {bee} landed on the flower and began to collect pollen.
translation: Пчела села на цветок и начала собирать пыльцу.

definition: to experience something difficult, such as a medical treatment
sentence: My dad will {undergo} knee surgery next week.
translation: На следующей неделе папе будут делать операцию на колене.

definition: a large musical instrument with black and white keys
sentence: She practices the {piano} for an hour every day.
translation: Она занимается на пианино по часу каждый день.

definition: money paid to someone because they have suffered loss or injury
sentence: The airline paid {compensation} for the lost luggage.
translation: Авиакомпания выплатила компенсацию за потерянный багаж.

definition: the protection of nature, animals and old buildings
sentence: The park was created for the {conservation} of rare birds.
translation: Парк создали для сохранения редких птиц.

definition: relating to or allowed by the constitution of a country
sentence: The court decided that the new law was not {constitutional}.
translation: Суд решил, что новый закон не соответствует конституции.

definition: basic and simple, or relating to the first years of school
sentence: The course teaches {elementary} Spanish for travelers.
translation: Курс учит основам испанского для путешественников.

definition: relating to a group of people with the same race, culture or language
sentence: The city has many {ethnic} restaurants, from Thai to Turkish.
translation: В городе много этнических ресторанов, от тайских до турецких.

definition: very much
sentence: The town has changed {greatly} since I was a child.
translation: Город сильно изменился с тех пор, как я был ребёнком.

definition: help and advice about what to do
sentence: Young players need {guidance} from an experienced coach.
translation: Молодым игрокам нужно руководство опытного тренера.

definition: relating to machines, or done without thinking like a machine
sentence: The plane was delayed by a {mechanical} problem.
translation: Самолёт задержали из-за технической неисправности.

definition: the act of taking part in something
sentence: {Participation} in the sports day is open to all students.
translation: Участие в спортивном дне открыто для всех учеников.

definition: very valuable, or very important to you
sentence: The ring is made of gold and {precious} stones.
translation: Кольцо сделано из золота и драгоценных камней.

definition: important and well known, or easy to see
sentence: She is a {prominent} lawyer in the city.
translation: Она видный юрист в городе.

definition: relating to areas where people live rather than work
sentence: The factory is too noisy for a {residential} street.
translation: Завод слишком шумный для жилой улицы.

definition: large in size, amount or importance
sentence: She received a {substantial} pay rise this year.
translation: В этом году она получила существенную прибавку к зарплате.

definition: animals and plants that live in natural conditions
sentence: The forest is home to a lot of {wildlife}, including deer and foxes.
translation: Лес — дом для множества диких животных, включая оленей и лис.

definition: made of wood
sentence: The children sat on a long {wooden} bench.
translation: Дети сидели на длинной деревянной скамье.

definition: words asking for bad things to happen to someone, or a rude word
sentence: The old woman put a {curse} on the thief.
translation: Старуха наложила на вора проклятие.

definition: a skilled cook, especially the main cook in a restaurant
sentence: The {chef} came out of the kitchen to greet the guests.
translation: Шеф-повар вышел из кухни поприветствовать гостей.

definition: to decide in a court that someone is guilty of a crime
sentence: The jury took an hour to {convict} him of robbery.
translation: Присяжным понадобился час, чтобы признать его виновным в ограблении.

definition: to make someone feel very sad and without hope
sentence: Grey winter days {depress} me more than the cold itself.
translation: Серые зимние дни наводят на меня тоску сильнее, чем сам холод.

definition: to be not the same as something else
sentence: The two reports {differ} on the number of victims.
translation: Два отчёта расходятся в числе жертв.

definition: a dry substance made of very small pieces, like flour or dust
sentence: Mix the {powder} with water to make the paint.
translation: Смешай порошок с водой, чтобы получить краску.

definition: to notice or understand something, or to think of it in a particular way
sentence: Many people {perceive} the city as dangerous, but it is not.
translation: Многие воспринимают город как опасный, но это не так.

definition: to match or be similar to something, or to write letters to someone
sentence: The numbers on the map {correspond} to the rooms in the museum.
translation: Номера на карте соответствуют залам музея.

definition: a hard pointed part on a goat's head, or a loud car sound
sentence: The goat has a broken {horn}.
translation: У козла сломан рог.

definition: a conversation between two or more people, especially in a book or film
sentence: The film has very little {dialogue}; the pictures tell the story.
translation: В фильме очень мало диалогов, историю рассказывают кадры.

definition: to close or hit something with great force and a loud noise
sentence: Don't {slam} the car door; the baby is sleeping.
translation: Не хлопай дверью машины, ребёнок спит.

definition: the act of working together with others on something
sentence: The book is a {collaboration} between a writer and a photographer.
translation: Книга — совместная работа писателя и фотографа.

definition: a unit of length; there are a hundred in a meter
sentence: The box is thirty centimeters wide, so one extra {centimeter} will not fit.
translation: Коробка шириной тридцать сантиметров, так что лишний сантиметр не влезет.

definition: a collection of gold, jewels or other valuable things
sentence: The pirates buried their {treasure} on the island.
translation: Пираты закопали свои сокровища на острове.

definition: the number 50
sentence: There were about {fifty} people at the party.
translation: На вечеринке было около пятидесяти человек.

definition: the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters
sentence: The {headline} said the bridge would close for a year.
translation: Заголовок гласил, что мост закроют на год.

definition: the top of a mountain, or a meeting between leaders of countries
sentence: They reached the {summit} just as the sun rose.
translation: Они достигли вершины как раз на рассвете.

definition: a group of people who have come together for a purpose
sentence: There was a small {gathering} of friends at her house.
translation: У неё дома собрались несколько друзей.

definition: the bottom part of a shoe or of the foot
sentence: The {sole} of my boot has a hole in it.
translation: В подошве моего ботинка дыра.

definition: the small hard seeds of plants such as wheat or rice, or a tiny piece
sentence: The farmers store the {grain} in large metal towers.
translation: Фермеры хранят зерно в больших металлических башнях.

definition: a piece of land that sticks out into the sea, or a coat without sleeves
sentence: The lighthouse stands on the {cape} at the end of the bay.
translation: Маяк стоит на мысе в конце залива.

definition: a list of the food and drinks available in a restaurant
sentence: The waiter brought us the {menu} and a jug of water.
translation: Официант принёс нам меню и кувшин воды.

definition: to touch someone or something gently with a flat hand
sentence: She bent down to {pat} the dog on the head.
translation: Она наклонилась, чтобы погладить собаку по голове.

definition: said when you leave someone or they leave you
sentence: {Goodbye}, and thank you for a lovely evening.
translation: До свидания, и спасибо за чудесный вечер.

definition: a person or thing that takes the place of another
sentence: The coach sent on a {substitute} after the injury.
translation: Тренер выпустил замену после травмы.

definition: a police officer whose job is to find out who committed a crime
sentence: The {detective} found a hair on the broken window.
translation: Детектив нашёл волос на разбитом окне.

definition: angry and ready to attack or argue, or very forceful
sentence: The dog became {aggressive} when strangers came near.
translation: Собака становилась агрессивной, когда приближались чужие.

definition: easy to see or understand, obvious
sentence: It was {apparent} from her face that she hadn't slept.
translation: По её лицу было видно, что она не спала.

definition: the ability to do something dangerous or difficult without showing fear
sentence: It took great {courage} to jump into the icy river.
translation: Нужна была большая смелость, чтобы прыгнуть в ледяную реку.

definition: needing or wanting something so much that you will do anything
sentence: I'm {desperate} for a holiday after this month.
translation: После этого месяца мне отчаянно нужен отпуск.

definition: the fact of including many different types of people or things
sentence: The city is proud of the {diversity} of its people.
translation: Город гордится разнообразием своих жителей.

definition: information about how good or bad something is, given so it can be improved
sentence: The teacher gave useful {feedback} on my essay.
translation: Учитель дал полезные замечания по моему эссе.

definition: relating to making laws
sentence: Parliament has {legislative} power; the courts do not.
translation: Законодательная власть у парламента, а не у судов.

definition: the job of caring for sick or old people
sentence: She left teaching to study {nursing}.
translation: Она ушла из преподавания, чтобы учиться на медсестру.

definition: continuing to happen or develop
sentence: The investigation into the fire is still {ongoing}.
translation: Расследование пожара всё ещё продолжается.

definition: causing physical pain, or very unpleasant
sentence: The injection was quick but {painful}.
translation: Укол был быстрым, но болезненным.

definition: of a color between red and blue
sentence: She wore a {purple} scarf with her black coat.
translation: На ней был фиолетовый шарф с чёрным пальто.

definition: as much as is needed; enough
sentence: Two hours is {sufficient} to see the whole museum.
translation: Двух часов достаточно, чтобы осмотреть весь музей.

definition: below the surface of the ground
sentence: The city has an {underground} car park beneath the square.
translation: В городе есть подземная парковка под площадью.

definition: existing on a computer or the internet rather than in the real world
sentence: The students took a {virtual} tour of the museum from their classroom.
translation: Ученики совершили виртуальную экскурсию по музею из своего класса.

definition: a sweet food made from sugar or chocolate
sentence: The children got a bag of {candy} at the party.
translation: Дети получили на вечеринке пакетик конфет.

definition: an explanation of the meaning of something, or a way of performing it
sentence: Each reader will have a different {interpretation} of the poem.
translation: У каждого читателя будет своё толкование стихотворения.

definition: a very frightening dream, or a very bad experience
sentence: She woke up screaming after a {nightmare} about snakes.
translation: Она проснулась с криком после кошмара о змеях.

definition: something that makes people want to visit a place, or the feeling of liking someone
sentence: The old castle is the main {attraction} of the town.
translation: Старый замок — главная достопримечательность города.

definition: to expect something and get ready for it
sentence: I didn't {anticipate} so many people coming to the party.
translation: Я не ожидал, что на вечеринку придёт столько людей.

definition: an object with metal pins that connects a device to the electricity supply
sentence: The {plug} of the lamp does not fit the socket.
translation: Вилка лампы не подходит к розетке.

definition: a medical operation to end a pregnancy
sentence: The law on {abortion} is different in every country.
translation: Закон об абортах в каждой стране свой.

definition: to bend something, such as paper or cloth, so that one part lies on another
sentence: {Fold} the letter in half and put it in the envelope.
translation: Сложи письмо пополам и положи в конверт.

definition: a tool with a heavy metal head used for hitting nails
sentence: He hit his thumb with the {hammer}.
translation: Он ударил себя молотком по большому пальцу.

definition: to say or describe something clearly and exactly
sentence: The recipe does not {specify} how much salt to use.
translation: В рецепте не указано, сколько соли класть.

definition: a lot of public disagreement and argument about something
sentence: The new parking fee caused a lot of {controversy} in town.
translation: Новая плата за парковку вызвала в городе много споров.

definition: something you believe is true without any proof
sentence: You made the {assumption} that I would pay for dinner.
translation: Ты просто решил, что за ужин заплачу я.

definition: a place where people go to drink beer and other alcohol, common in Britain
sentence: We had lunch in a {pub} by the river.
translation: Мы пообедали в пабе у реки.

definition: a neat pile of things placed one on top of another
sentence: There was a {stack} of plates on the table.
translation: На столе стояла стопка тарелок.

definition: the flat inside part of the hand, or a tall tree of hot countries
sentence: She held the coin in the {palm} of her hand.
translation: Она держала монету на ладони.

definition: a person who believes that industry should be owned by the state and wealth shared
sentence: As a {socialist}, he wants higher taxes for the rich.
translation: Как социалист, он хочет более высоких налогов для богатых.

definition: the act of putting equipment in place and making it ready to use
sentence: The {installation} of the new boiler took a whole day.
translation: Установка нового котла заняла целый день.

definition: the fact of liking one thing more than another
sentence: I have a {preference} for tea over coffee.
translation: Я предпочитаю чай кофе.

definition: to curve something, or to move the top of your body downwards
sentence: {Bend} your knees before you lift the box.
translation: Согни колени, прежде чем поднимать коробку.

definition: a small computer that you can carry and use on your knees
sentence: She writes all her books on an old {laptop}.
translation: Она пишет все свои книги на старом ноутбуке.

definition: to officially suggest someone for a job, prize or position
sentence: The club will {nominate} her for the award.
translation: Клуб выдвинет её на награду.

definition: a collection of weapons, or a building where they are stored
sentence: Police found an {arsenal} of guns in the basement.
translation: Полиция нашла в подвале целый арсенал оружия.

definition: relating to living things and the science of life
sentence: The {biological} clock tells animals when to sleep.
translation: Биологические часы подсказывают животным, когда спать.

definition: unfair treatment of people because of their race, sex, age or religion
sentence: The law forbids {discrimination} against older workers.
translation: Закон запрещает дискриминацию пожилых работников.

definition: full of energy and new ideas, or always changing
sentence: The new manager is young and {dynamic}.
translation: Новый менеджер молод и энергичен.

definition: film of an event, especially recorded by a camera
sentence: The news showed {footage} of the flood from a helicopter.
translation: В новостях показали кадры наводнения с вертолёта.

definition: a type of music with strong rhythm in which players often invent as they play
sentence: We listened to {jazz} in a small club until two in the morning.
translation: Мы слушали джаз в маленьком клубе до двух часов ночи.

definition: relating to literature, or typical of serious writing
sentence: She won a {literary} prize for her first novel.
translation: Она получила литературную премию за свой первый роман.

definition: the middle of the night, when one day ends and the next begins
sentence: The party went on until well past {midnight}.
translation: Вечеринка продолжалась далеко за полночь.

definition: the study of the mind and how it affects behavior
sentence: She studied {psychology} and became a school counselor.
translation: Она изучала психологию и стала школьным психологом.

definition: the state of being steady and not likely to change or fall
sentence: After years of war, the country finally has some {stability}.
translation: После многих лет войны в стране наконец наступила некоторая стабильность.

definition: not changing, continuing at the same level
sentence: Keep a {steady} pace and you'll finish the run.
translation: Держи ровный темп, и ты добежишь.

definition: not expected to happen or be true
sentence: It is {unlikely} to rain tomorrow.
translation: Завтра вряд ли будет дождь.

definition: the flat top of your legs when you sit, or one round of a track
sentence: The cat jumped onto her {lap} and went to sleep.
translation: Кошка запрыгнула ей на колени и уснула.

definition: to break open suddenly, or to make something do this
sentence: The balloon will {burst} if you blow any more air into it.
translation: Шарик лопнет, если надуть его ещё сильнее.

definition: to make or design something that did not exist before
sentence: Who was the first to {invent} the telephone?
translation: Кто первым изобрёл телефон?

definition: fruit or meat cooked inside a case of soft bread-like dough
sentence: Grandma baked an apple {pie} for dessert.
translation: Бабушка испекла яблочный пирог на десерт.

definition: a heavy duty or worry that is difficult to carry
sentence: I don't want to be a {burden} on my parents.
translation: Я не хочу быть обузой для родителей.

definition: the time of day when light first appears
sentence: We left the camp at {dawn} to climb the mountain.
translation: Мы вышли из лагеря на рассвете, чтобы подняться на гору.

definition: a very small piece of burning material or flash of electricity
sentence: A {spark} from the fire landed on the carpet.
translation: Искра от огня упала на ковёр.

definition: a number of things lying on top of each other
sentence: There is a {pile} of dirty clothes on the floor.
translation: На полу куча грязной одежды.

definition: the choice of the moment when something happens
sentence: The {timing} of the announcement was perfect.
translation: Момент для объявления был выбран идеально.

definition: a person who sits on and controls a horse, bicycle or motorcycle
sentence: The {rider} fell off the horse at the last jump.
translation: Всадник упал с лошади на последнем препятствии.

definition: a long narrow opening for putting something in, or a place in a schedule
sentence: Put the coin in the {slot} and press the button.
translation: Опусти монету в щель и нажми кнопку.

definition: one of the flat green parts of a plant that grow from the stem
sentence: A single yellow {leaf} fell from the tree.
translation: С дерева упал один жёлтый лист.

definition: the Earth, or a round model of it
sentence: The teacher turned the {globe} to show us Australia.
translation: Учитель повернул глобус, чтобы показать нам Австралию.

definition: happening often
sentence: There are {frequent} buses to the airport.
translation: Автобусы в аэропорт ходят часто.

definition: a person whose job is to design buildings
sentence: The {architect} showed us a model of the new library.
translation: Архитектор показал нам макет новой библиотеки.

definition: two slices of bread with cheese, meat or other food between them
sentence: I had a ham {sandwich} for lunch.
translation: На обед я съел сэндвич с ветчиной.

definition: heavy, sticky earth that becomes hard when baked, used for making pots
sentence: The children made small animals out of {clay}.
translation: Дети лепили маленьких животных из глины.

definition: to spend most of your time studying or doing one particular thing
sentence: The restaurant decided to {specialize} in fish dishes.
translation: Ресторан решил специализироваться на рыбных блюдах.

definition: a type of film, music or book with a particular style
sentence: Horror is her favorite film {genre}.
translation: Ужасы — её любимый жанр кино.

definition: to give most of your time or attention to one thing
sentence: He {devotes} every Sunday morning to his garden.
translation: Каждое воскресное утро он отдаёт своему саду.

definition: to remove or take something out, often with effort
sentence: The dentist had to {extract} two of my teeth.
translation: Стоматологу пришлось удалить два моих зуба.

definition: a long search for something important
sentence: The knights set out on a {quest} for the lost crown.
translation: Рыцари отправились на поиски потерянной короны.

definition: a shop that sells one company's goods, or a way of expressing feelings
sentence: The brand opened an {outlet} in the new shopping center.
translation: Бренд открыл магазин в новом торговом центре.

definition: to lose blood from the body
sentence: The cut on his hand began to {bleed} again.
translation: Порез на его руке снова закровоточил.

definition: what you plan or mean to do
sentence: He entered the house with {intent} to steal.
translation: Он вошёл в дом с намерением украсть.

definition: the band of colors that light splits into, or a full range of something
sentence: Views on the subject cover the whole {spectrum} from love to hate.
translation: Мнения по этому вопросу охватывают весь спектр от любви до ненависти.

definition: an extremely small piece of something
sentence: A {particle} of dust got into my eye.
translation: Частичка пыли попала мне в глаз.

definition: shared or done by all the members of a group
sentence: The decision was a {collective} one, made by the whole team.
translation: Решение было коллективным, его приняла вся команда.

definition: the act of working together to achieve something
sentence: The project needs {cooperation} between the two schools.
translation: Проекту нужно сотрудничество двух школ.

definition: the state of having no light
sentence: The {darkness} of the forest frightened the children.
translation: Темнота леса напугала детей.

definition: the machines and physical parts of a computer, or tools and metal goods
sentence: The shop sells computer {hardware} but no software.
translation: Магазин продаёт компьютерное железо, но не программы.

definition: the act of taking part in something
sentence: His {involvement} in the robbery was never proved.
translation: Его участие в ограблении так и не было доказано.

definition: to some degree but not completely
sentence: The accident was {partly} her fault.
translation: Авария произошла отчасти по её вине.

definition: in a way that relates to the body rather than the mind
sentence: The job is {physically} hard but well paid.
translation: Работа физически тяжёлая, но хорошо оплачивается.

definition: relating to a person's race, or to relations between races
sentence: The school has students from many {racial} backgrounds.
translation: В школе учатся дети разных рас.

definition: in a similar way; also
sentence: The two brothers dress {similarly} and even talk alike.
translation: Два брата одеваются похоже и даже говорят одинаково.

definition: having a natural ability to do something well
sentence: She is a {talented} singer with a strong voice.
translation: Она талантливая певица с сильным голосом.

definition: the ability to make good decisions based on knowledge and experience
sentence: With age comes {wisdom}, or so people say.
translation: С возрастом приходит мудрость, во всяком случае так говорят.

definition: a small picture on a computer screen, or a famous person who represents something
sentence: Click the {icon} to open the program.
translation: Нажми на иконку, чтобы открыть программу.

definition: a doctor who performs operations
sentence: The {surgeon} removed the tumor in a three-hour operation.
translation: Хирург удалил опухоль за трёхчасовую операцию.

definition: needing someone or something in order to live or continue
sentence: The village is {dependent} on tourists for its income.
translation: Доход деревни зависит от туристов.

definition: the way you see or understand something
sentence: My {perception} of the city changed after a week there.
translation: Моё восприятие города изменилось после недели там.

definition: a planned way of doing something to achieve an aim
sentence: Lowering prices is a common {tactic} to win customers.
translation: Снижение цен — обычная тактика привлечения покупателей.

definition: to press and move your hand or a cloth over a surface
sentence: {Rub} the cream into your skin until it disappears.
translation: Втирай крем в кожу, пока он не впитается.

definition: having high moral qualities, or belonging to the highest social class
sentence: Giving up his seat was a small but {noble} act.
translation: Уступить место — маленький, но благородный поступок.

definition: the legal right to control who can copy a book, song or film
sentence: The book is protected by {copyright} for seventy years.
translation: Книга защищена авторским правом семьдесят лет.

definition: the act of allowing someone to enter, or of saying that something is true
sentence: {Admission} to the museum is free on Sundays.
translation: Вход в музей по воскресеньям бесплатный.

definition: a drug used to treat an illness
sentence: He takes {medication} for high blood pressure.
translation: Он принимает лекарство от высокого давления.

definition: a set of official rules for behavior, or for how computers exchange data
sentence: Royal {protocol} says you should not touch the queen.
translation: Королевский протокол гласит, что королеву трогать нельзя.

definition: money given to a student to pay for their studies
sentence: She won a {scholarship} to study music in Vienna.
translation: Она получила стипендию на обучение музыке в Вене.

definition: to become well again after an injury, or to make someone well
sentence: The cut will {heal} in about a week.
translation: Порез заживёт примерно за неделю.

definition: to take hold of something quickly and with force
sentence: He {seized} my arm as I was about to fall.
translation: Он схватил меня за руку, когда я чуть не упал.

definition: to cause someone to do something, or to remind an actor of their words
sentence: The crash will {prompt} new safety rules for buses.
translation: Авария побудит ввести новые правила безопасности для автобусов.

definition: the act of changing something into a different form or use
sentence: The {conversion} of the barn into a house took a year.
translation: Переделка амбара в дом заняла год.

definition: a thin pointed stick shot from a bow, or a sign shaped like it
sentence: The {arrow} on the sign points to the exit.
translation: Стрелка на знаке указывает на выход.

definition: to make people obey a rule or law
sentence: Nobody {enforces} the parking rules on this street.
translation: На этой улице никто не следит за правилами парковки.

definition: a sound that you hear again because it bounces back off a wall or hill
sentence: Her shout came back as an {echo} from the cliff.
translation: Её крик вернулся эхом от скалы.

definition: a legal action in a court
sentence: The {proceeding} against the company began on Monday.
translation: Судебное разбирательство против компании началось в понедельник.

definition: to put something into a liquid for a short time, or to go down slightly
sentence: {Dip} the bread in the sauce before you eat it.
translation: Обмакни хлеб в соус, прежде чем есть.

definition: to stop happening or stop doing something
sentence: The noise upstairs finally {ceased} after midnight.
translation: Шум наверху наконец прекратился после полуночи.

definition: a person or animal you spend a lot of time with
sentence: The old dog was her only {companion} after her husband died.
translation: Старый пёс был её единственным спутником после смерти мужа.

definition: very strong anger that you cannot control
sentence: He threw the phone against the wall in a {rage}.
translation: В ярости он швырнул телефон о стену.

definition: something said or done to show respect or admiration for someone
sentence: The concert was a {tribute} to the singer who died last year.
translation: Концерт стал данью памяти певцу, умершему в прошлом году.

definition: the salty liquid that comes out of your skin when you are hot or afraid
sentence: His shirt was wet with {sweat} after the run.
translation: Его рубашка после пробежки промокла от пота.

definition: covered in the red liquid from a wound, or with a lot of killing
sentence: The soldier came back with a {bloody} bandage on his arm.
translation: Солдат вернулся с окровавленной повязкой на руке.

definition: a long narrow channel of water dug for boats or for carrying water to fields
sentence: Boats carried coal along the {canal} to the city.
translation: Лодки возили уголь по каналу в город.

definition: a person who attacks ships at sea to steal from them
sentence: The {pirate} buried the gold on a small island.
translation: Пират закопал золото на маленьком острове.

definition: an official piece of advice about how something should be done
sentence: The new {guideline} says children should sleep ten hours a night.
translation: Новая рекомендация гласит, что дети должны спать десять часов в сутки.

definition: a very small round mark
sentence: Put a {dot} at the end of the sentence.
translation: Поставь точку в конце предложения.

definition: the range of things that something deals with or covers
sentence: Repairing the roof is outside the {scope} of this project.
translation: Ремонт крыши не входит в рамки этого проекта.

definition: the sister of your mother or father, or the wife of your uncle
sentence: My {aunt} lives in Canada and visits every summer.
translation: Моя тётя живёт в Канаде и приезжает каждое лето.

definition: a tight hold on something
sentence: Keep a firm {grip} on the rope as you climb.
translation: Крепко держись за верёвку, когда поднимаешься.

definition: the job of keeping and checking financial records
sentence: She studied {accounting} and now works for a large bank.
translation: Она изучала бухгалтерский учёт и теперь работает в крупном банке.

definition: making you feel shy and not comfortable
sentence: There was an {awkward} silence after his joke.
translation: После его шутки повисло неловкое молчание.

definition: the meat of a cow
sentence: We had roast {beef} with potatoes for Sunday lunch.
translation: На воскресный обед у нас была жареная говядина с картошкой.

definition: clearly different or separate from other things
sentence: The two cheeses have very {distinct} tastes.
translation: У этих двух сыров совершенно разный вкус.

definition: allowed to do or have something because you meet the rules
sentence: You're {eligible} for a discount if you're under 26.
translation: Если тебе меньше 26, тебе положена скидка.

definition: large movable objects such as tables, chairs and beds
sentence: The flat came with all its {furniture}.
translation: Квартира сдавалась со всей мебелью.

definition: able to learn and understand things quickly and well
sentence: Dolphins are highly {intelligent} animals that learn fast.
translation: Дельфины — очень умные животные, которые быстро учатся.

definition: in or to a foreign country across the sea
sentence: Many students go {overseas} to study for a year.
translation: Многие студенты уезжают за границу учиться на год.

definition: able to be trusted to work well or to do what you expect
sentence: We need a {reliable} car for the long trip.
translation: Нам нужна надёжная машина для долгой поездки.

definition: unusual and surprising in a way that you notice
sentence: The patient made a {remarkable} recovery in just a week.
translation: Пациент удивительно быстро восстановился всего за неделю.

definition: deserving respect, attention or support
sentence: The money goes to a {worthy} cause: a children's hospital.
translation: Деньги идут на достойное дело — детскую больницу.

definition: a sudden strong feeling of excitement and pleasure
sentence: Riding the roller coaster gave me a real {thrill}.
translation: Катание на американских горках по-настоящему взволновало меня.

definition: an image that you see in a mirror or water, or careful thought
sentence: She saw her {reflection} in the shop window.
translation: Она увидела своё отражение в витрине магазина.

definition: a prize, often a silver cup, given to the winner of a competition
sentence: The captain lifted the {trophy} above his head.
translation: Капитан поднял кубок над головой.

definition: to say what is wrong or bad about someone or something
sentence: It is easy to {criticize} a film you have not even seen.
translation: Легко критиковать фильм, которого даже не видел.

definition: to take in a liquid, heat or information
sentence: A sponge will {absorb} the water quickly.
translation: Губка быстро впитает воду.

definition: a baby bird, especially a baby hen
sentence: A yellow {chick} followed the hen across the yard.
translation: Жёлтый цыплёнок бежал за курицей по двору.

definition: something added to make something complete or better, such as vitamins
sentence: She takes a vitamin {supplement} every morning.
translation: Она каждое утро принимает витаминную добавку.

definition: a long walk in the countryside
sentence: We went on a six-hour {hike} through the hills.
translation: Мы отправились в шестичасовой поход по холмам.

definition: the male ruler of an empire
sentence: The {emperor} ruled over lands from Spain to Egypt.
translation: Император правил землями от Испании до Египта.

definition: a secret plan by a group of people to do something bad or illegal
sentence: They were arrested for a {conspiracy} to rob the bank.
translation: Их арестовали за заговор с целью ограбления банка.

definition: the part of a coat or jacket that covers the head
sentence: Put your {hood} up; it is starting to rain.
translation: Накинь капюшон, начинается дождь.

definition: demanding that rules are obeyed, or very exact
sentence: Our teacher is {strict} about homework being on time.
translation: Наша учительница строго следит, чтобы домашнее задание сдавали вовремя.

definition: the length of time something lasts, or the distance between two ends
sentence: The average life {span} of a cat is about fifteen years.
translation: Средняя продолжительность жизни кошки — около пятнадцати лет.

definition: the device that makes a vehicle slow down or stop
sentence: The {brake} on my bike does not work properly.
translation: Тормоз на моём велосипеде плохо работает.

definition: a thin flat piece cut from something larger
sentence: Would you like another {slice} of cake?
translation: Хочешь ещё кусочек торта?

definition: a small round piece of medicine that you swallow, or a flat computer
sentence: Take one {tablet} three times a day with food.
translation: Принимай по одной таблетке три раза в день во время еды.

definition: a person or company that competes with others
sentence: The shop lost customers to a cheaper {competitor}.
translation: Магазин потерял покупателей из-за более дешёвого конкурента.

definition: to make a machine, system or process start working
sentence: Press this button to {activate} the alarm.
translation: Нажми эту кнопку, чтобы включить сигнализацию.

definition: a very narrow beam of strong light used in medicine, industry and shows
sentence: The doctor used a {laser} to remove the mark on her skin.
translation: Врач удалил пятно на её коже лазером.

definition: one of the foods used to make a dish
sentence: The only {ingredient} we are missing is garlic.
translation: Единственный ингредиент, которого нам не хватает, — чеснок.

definition: a thick piece of soft material, or sheets of paper joined at one edge
sentence: He wrote the address on a {pad} of paper.
translation: Он записал адрес в блокноте.

definition: to be the king or queen of a country
sentence: The queen was to {reign} for seventy years.
translation: Королеве предстояло править семьдесят лет.

definition: a container for rubbish
sentence: Throw the empty bottle in the {bin}.
translation: Выбрось пустую бутылку в мусорное ведро.

definition: to slowly become less bright, less loud or less strong
sentence: The colors of the curtains began to {fade} in the sun.
translation: Цвета штор начали выцветать на солнце.

definition: to put something inside something else
sentence: {Insert} your card and enter your PIN.
translation: Вставьте карту и введите ПИН-код.

definition: a wonderful event that cannot be explained by nature or science
sentence: It was a {miracle} that nobody was hurt in the crash.
translation: Чудо, что никто не пострадал в аварии.

definition: having a lot of money and possessions
sentence: A {wealthy} businessman bought the old castle.
translation: Богатый бизнесмен купил старый замок.

definition: a natural substance such as salt or iron found in the earth, or in food
sentence: Milk contains calcium, a {mineral} that makes bones strong.
translation: В молоке есть кальций — минерал, укрепляющий кости.

definition: the reason or desire that makes you want to do something
sentence: Money is not his main {motivation} for working.
translation: Деньги — не главный мотив его работы.

definition: a large tree with hard wood that lives for hundreds of years
sentence: An old {oak} stands in the middle of the field.
translation: Посреди поля стоит старый дуб.

definition: a group of soldiers or police who go around an area to guard it
sentence: A police {patrol} passes the shop every hour.
translation: Полицейский патруль проходит мимо магазина каждый час.

definition: to move back or away from a place or enemy
sentence: The soldiers had to {retreat} across the river.
translation: Солдатам пришлось отступить за реку.

definition: the special chair of a king or queen, or the position of ruler
sentence: The young prince was next in line to the {throne}.
translation: Юный принц был следующим в очереди на трон.

definition: the back part of the foot, or the part of a shoe under it
sentence: My new shoes have rubbed the skin off my {heel}.
translation: Новые туфли натёрли мне пятку.

definition: a building where you keep a car, or a place where cars are repaired
sentence: The car is in the {garage} being repaired.
translation: Машина в мастерской на ремонте.

definition: to heat a liquid until it bubbles, or to cook food in very hot water
sentence: {Boil} the eggs for five minutes.
translation: Вари яйца пять минут.

definition: a person who does something for pleasure and not as a job
sentence: He plays football as an {amateur} at weekends.
translation: По выходным он играет в футбол как любитель.

definition: a standard by which something is judged or decided
sentence: Price is the main {criterion} for most buyers.
translation: Цена — главный критерий для большинства покупателей.

definition: a person who buys and sells goods in large amounts
sentence: The wine {merchant} imports bottles from Italy and Spain.
translation: Виноторговец импортирует вино из Италии и Испании.

definition: to do what is required, or to achieve something you hoped for
sentence: The company failed to {fulfill} its promise to the workers.
translation: Компания не выполнила своего обещания рабочим.

definition: brave and confident, or very clear and strong to look at
sentence: It was a {bold} decision to leave her job and start a business.
translation: Бросить работу и открыть своё дело было смелым решением.

definition: a long thin piece of leather on a handle, used for hitting animals
sentence: The rider cracked his {whip} and the horse began to run.
translation: Всадник щёлкнул кнутом, и лошадь побежала.

definition: very great fear
sentence: The children screamed in {terror} when the lights went out.
translation: Дети закричали от ужаса, когда погас свет.

definition: a statement of what is likely to happen, especially with the weather
sentence: The {forecast} says it will snow tomorrow.
translation: Прогноз обещает завтра снег.

definition: the lowest part in music, or a low-sounding instrument or voice
sentence: He plays {bass} in a jazz band.
translation: Он играет на бас-гитаре в джазовой группе.

definition: extremely important for the result of something
sentence: The next two weeks are {crucial} for the project.
translation: Следующие две недели решают судьбу проекта.

definition: having two parts or purposes
sentence: She has {dual} citizenship: Spanish and Argentine.
translation: У неё двойное гражданство: испанское и аргентинское.

definition: relating to tests done to discover something, or new and not yet proved
sentence: The new drug is still at an {experimental} stage.
translation: Новый препарат пока на экспериментальной стадии.

definition: a large area of sea partly surrounded by land, or a big difference
sentence: The ship sailed into the {gulf} at sunset.
translation: Корабль вошёл в залив на закате.

definition: quiet and calm, or without war or violence
sentence: The village is {peaceful} after the tourists leave.
translation: После отъезда туристов в деревне тихо и спокойно.

definition: the act of stopping something bad from happening
sentence: Washing hands is the best {prevention} against colds.
translation: Мытьё рук — лучшая профилактика простуды.

definition: in a way that everyone can see or know about
sentence: The minister {publicly} apologized for his words.
translation: Министр публично извинился за свои слова.

definition: something you do to hurt someone because they hurt you
sentence: He wanted {revenge} on the man who stole his car.
translation: Он хотел отомстить человеку, который украл его машину.

definition: the business of providing holidays and services for visitors
sentence: The island depends on {tourism} for most of its money.
translation: Остров живёт в основном за счёт туризма.

definition: the act of stopping something for a time, or of banning someone for a time
sentence: The player received a three-match {suspension} for the foul.
translation: Игрок получил дисквалификацию на три матча за нарушение.

definition: to cause something to happen, or to persuade someone to do something
sentence: Hot weather can {induce} headaches in some people.
translation: Жаркая погода может вызывать головную боль у некоторых людей.

definition: an animal with a long tail that lives in trees in hot countries
sentence: A {monkey} stole a banana from my bag.
translation: Обезьяна стащила банан из моей сумки.

definition: an amount or number of something
sentence: Buy a small {quantity} of rice first to see if you like it.
translation: Купи сначала небольшое количество риса, чтобы понять, нравится ли он тебе.

definition: a person who gives expert advice to companies, or a senior hospital doctor
sentence: The firm hired a {consultant} to improve its sales.
translation: Фирма наняла консультанта, чтобы улучшить продажи.

definition: something that happens or exists, especially something unusual or interesting
sentence: The northern lights are a natural {phenomenon}.
translation: Северное сияние — природное явление.

definition: a hot-tasting powder used to flavor food, or a hollow red, green or yellow vegetable
sentence: Add salt and {pepper} to the soup.
translation: Добавь в суп соль и перец.

definition: an act of breaking a law, rule or agreement, or a gap in a wall
sentence: Selling the photos was a {breach} of the contract.
translation: Продажа фотографий была нарушением контракта.

definition: a member of a youth group that learns outdoor skills
sentence: The {scout} learned to light a fire without matches.
translation: Скаут научился разводить огонь без спичек.

definition: a group of states or organizations joined together under one central body
sentence: The football {federation} banned the club for a year.
translation: Футбольная федерация отстранила клуб на год.

definition: the first public performance of a film or play
sentence: The stars arrived in limousines for the {premiere}.
translation: Звёзды прибыли на премьеру на лимузинах.

definition: to consider or judge something in a particular way
sentence: The bridge was deemed unsafe, and engineers {deem} repairs impossible.
translation: Мост признали небезопасным, а ремонт инженеры считают невозможным.

definition: the fact of being found guilty in court, or a strong belief
sentence: He had an earlier {conviction} for theft.
translation: У него уже была судимость за кражу.

definition: to take and use something that you will give back later
sentence: Can I {borrow} your pen for a minute?
translation: Можно одолжить у тебя ручку на минутку?

definition: a judgment about the quality, value or importance of something
sentence: The teacher wrote an {evaluation} of each student's work.
translation: Учитель написал оценку работы каждого ученика.

definition: to act in a particular way, or to act politely and correctly
sentence: The children {behave} well when their grandmother visits.
translation: Дети ведут себя хорошо, когда приезжает бабушка.

definition: to make something start
sentence: The government will {initiate} talks with the unions next week.
translation: Правительство начнёт переговоры с профсоюзами на следующей неделе.

definition: to push a knife into someone or something
sentence: The man tried to {stab} the guard with a kitchen knife.
translation: Мужчина попытался ударить охранника кухонным ножом.

definition: to state officially that something is true or correct
sentence: A doctor must {certify} that you are fit to work.
translation: Врач должен официально подтвердить, что вы годны к работе.

definition: a person whose job is to manage an organization or system
sentence: The hospital {administrator} is responsible for the budget.
translation: Администратор больницы отвечает за бюджет.

definition: to spring up or away after hitting a surface, like a ball
sentence: The ball will {bounce} higher on a hard floor.
translation: Мяч будет отскакивать выше от твёрдого пола.

definition: a room in a school where lessons take place
sentence: Our {classroom} is on the second floor next to the library.
translation: Наш класс на втором этаже рядом с библиотекой.

definition: to risk money on a game or race, hoping to win more
sentence: He lost his house because he liked to {gamble} on horses.
translation: Он потерял дом, потому что любил делать ставки на лошадей.

definition: an aircraft with large blades on top that can fly straight up and hover
sentence: A {helicopter} took the injured climber to hospital.
translation: Вертолёт доставил раненого альпиниста в больницу.

definition: a complete change in the form or character of something
sentence: The old factory has undergone a {transformation} into flats.
translation: Старый завод полностью переделали в квартиры.

definition: to talk to and do things with other people, or to affect each other
sentence: Children learn to {interact} with others at nursery school.
translation: Дети учатся общаться с другими в детском саду.

definition: to say very strongly that something is wrong or bad
sentence: Leaders around the world {condemn} the attack on the school.
translation: Лидеры всего мира осуждают нападение на школу.

definition: to make something continue for a longer time, or to make it new again
sentence: I need to {renew} my passport before the trip.
translation: Мне нужно продлить паспорт перед поездкой.

definition: good enough to be allowed or agreed to
sentence: The hotel was not luxurious, but it was {acceptable}.
translation: Отель не был роскошным, но вполне приемлемым.

definition: a state of complete confusion with no order
sentence: The kitchen was total {chaos} after the kids' party.
translation: После детского праздника на кухне был полный хаос.

definition: a soft reddish-brown metal used for wires and pipes
sentence: Old houses often have {copper} water pipes.
translation: В старых домах часто медные водопроводные трубы.

definition: the money a person or company gets for work or business
sentence: Her {earnings} doubled after she changed jobs.
translation: Её заработок удвоился после смены работы.

definition: extremely funny
sentence: The film was {hilarious}; we laughed from start to finish.
translation: Фильм был уморительный, мы смеялись от начала до конца.

definition: relating to the mind and the way people think and feel
sentence: The war left deep {psychological} scars on the soldiers.
translation: Война оставила глубокие психологические раны у солдат.

definition: a form of energy that can be dangerous, sent out from some substances
sentence: Workers at the plant are checked for {radiation} every month.
translation: Рабочих станции каждый месяц проверяют на облучение.

definition: in or to any place
sentence: Sit {wherever} you like; there are plenty of seats.
translation: Садитесь, где хотите, мест много.

definition: a person's job, or the act of taking control of a place by force
sentence: Please write your name and {occupation} on the form.
translation: Пожалуйста, укажите в форме имя и род занятий.

definition: a large house with a garden, often in the countryside or by the sea
sentence: They rented a {villa} with a pool for the summer.
translation: Они сняли на лето виллу с бассейном.

definition: to hit something by accident, often lightly
sentence: Mind you don't {bump} your head on the low ceiling.
translation: Смотри не ударься головой о низкий потолок.

definition: to decide what the meaning of something is
sentence: How do you {interpret} his silence at dinner?
translation: Как ты понимаешь его молчание за ужином?

definition: a glass container with a wide opening and a lid, used for storing food
sentence: There is a {jar} of honey on the top shelf.
translation: На верхней полке стоит банка мёда.

definition: a large bag made of strong cloth or paper for carrying heavy things
sentence: The farmer carried a {sack} of potatoes on his shoulder.
translation: Фермер нёс на плече мешок картошки.

definition: a small coin worth one cent or one hundredth of a pound
sentence: He did not have a single {penny} left after the holiday.
translation: После отпуска у него не осталось ни гроша.

definition: to stop fighting and admit that you have lost
sentence: The soldiers decided to {surrender} rather than die.
translation: Солдаты решили сдаться, а не погибнуть.

definition: the entry of an army into a country to take control of it
sentence: The {invasion} began at dawn on the beaches.
translation: Вторжение началось на рассвете на пляжах.

definition: to use something, especially in an effective way
sentence: The school will {utilize} the old hall as a theater.
translation: Школа будет использовать старый зал как театр.

definition: the act of leaving a place, especially the start of a journey
sentence: The {departure} of the train was delayed by twenty minutes.
translation: Отправление поезда задержалось на двадцать минут.

definition: a very large grey animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk
sentence: An {elephant} can live for seventy years.
translation: Слон может жить семьдесят лет.

definition: a person whose job is to make bread and cakes
sentence: The {baker} starts work at four in the morning.
translation: Пекарь начинает работу в четыре утра.

definition: to move soldiers or equipment to a place where they are needed
sentence: The government will {deploy} troops to help after the earthquake.
translation: Правительство направит войска для помощи после землетрясения.

definition: the place in a hotel or office where visitors are welcomed, or a formal party
sentence: Leave your key at {reception} when you go out.
translation: Оставьте ключ на стойке регистрации, когда уходите.

definition: a building where films are shown, or films in general
sentence: We went to the {cinema} to see the new comedy.
translation: Мы сходили в кино на новую комедию.

definition: the act of suggesting someone for a job, prize or position
sentence: She received a {nomination} for best actress.
translation: Она получила номинацию на лучшую женскую роль.

definition: to change something to make it better or more correct
sentence: The author decided to {revise} the ending of the novel.
translation: Автор решил переработать концовку романа.

definition: the unit of money used in many countries such as France and Germany
sentence: A coffee costs about one {euro} in this cafe.
translation: Кофе в этом кафе стоит около одного евро.

definition: the way people from a particular place pronounce words
sentence: She speaks English with a strong French {accent}.
translation: Она говорит по-английски с сильным французским акцентом.

definition: words that say you are sorry for something you did
sentence: He sent her flowers with a note of {apology}.
translation: Он прислал ей цветы с запиской с извинениями.

definition: a sudden violent shaking of the ground
sentence: The {earthquake} destroyed half the old town.
translation: Землетрясение разрушило половину старого города.

definition: a person who directs or checks something, or a device that controls a machine
sentence: The air traffic {controller} told the plane to wait.
translation: Авиадиспетчер велел самолёту подождать.

definition: to make someone extremely afraid
sentence: Loud fireworks {terrify} my old dog.
translation: Громкие фейерверки приводят мою старую собаку в ужас.

definition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere
sentence: We took a {taxi} from the airport to the hotel.
translation: Мы взяли такси из аэропорта в отель.

definition: a set of connected rooms in a hotel, or a set of matching furniture
sentence: The singer stayed in the best {suite} in the hotel.
translation: Певица остановилась в лучшем люксе отеля.

definition: to break something into very small pieces or powder by crushing it
sentence: We {grind} the coffee beans just before making coffee.
translation: Мы мелем кофейные зёрна прямо перед варкой кофе.

definition: cartoon films and TV shows made in Japan
sentence: My brother watches {anime} every evening after school.
translation: Мой брат смотрит аниме каждый вечер после школы.

definition: the season between summer and winter, when leaves fall
sentence: The leaves turn red and gold in {autumn}.
translation: Осенью листья становятся красными и золотыми.

definition: relating to serious music of the European tradition, or to ancient Greece and Rome
sentence: She plays {classical} music on the piano.
translation: Она играет классическую музыку на фортепиано.

definition: the state of having the same rights and chances as everyone else
sentence: The law promises {equality} for men and women at work.
translation: Закон обещает равенство мужчин и женщин на работе.

definition: relating to government money, taxes and spending
sentence: The government's {fiscal} year ends in March.
translation: Финансовый год правительства заканчивается в марте.

definition: without a home; living on the streets
sentence: The charity gives hot meals to {homeless} people in winter.
translation: Благотворительная организация зимой раздаёт горячую еду бездомным.

definition: the ideas, tastes or activities that most people share
sentence: The style was once strange but is now part of the {mainstream}.
translation: Этот стиль когда-то был странным, а теперь стал мейнстримом.

definition: felt or done by two people towards each other, or shared by two people
sentence: They have a {mutual} friend who introduced them.
translation: У них есть общий друг, который их познакомил.

definition: spoken rather than written, or relating to the mouth
sentence: The course ends with an {oral} exam in French.
translation: Курс заканчивается устным экзаменом по французскому.

definition: almost completely
sentence: The shop was {virtually} empty at that hour.
translation: В тот час магазин был практически пуст.

definition: a small part on a plant that will grow into a flower or leaf
sentence: Every {bud} on the apple tree opened in the warm week.
translation: Каждая почка на яблоне раскрылась за тёплую неделю.

definition: to burst suddenly with great force and a loud noise
sentence: The old bomb could {explode} if anyone touches it.
translation: Старая бомба может взорваться, если кто-нибудь её тронет.

definition: a group of political parties or countries working together for a time
sentence: Three parties formed a {coalition} to run the country.
translation: Три партии образовали коалицию, чтобы управлять страной.

definition: a woman who is sexually attracted to other women
sentence: The film tells the story of a {lesbian} couple in the 1950s.
translation: Фильм рассказывает историю лесбийской пары в 1950-е.

definition: a wall built across a river to hold back water
sentence: The {dam} provides electricity for the whole valley.
translation: Плотина обеспечивает электричеством всю долину.

definition: an idea or belief about something
sentence: I have no {notion} of what she meant by that.
translation: Я понятия не имею, что она имела в виду.

definition: to damage something and make it less good, or to give a child too much
sentence: Don't let the rain {spoil} our picnic.
translation: Не дай дождю испортить наш пикник.

definition: legal responsibility for something, or a person or thing that causes problems
sentence: The company accepted {liability} for the accident.
translation: Компания признала ответственность за аварию.

definition: a careful check of something to see that it is correct or safe
sentence: The restaurant passed its health {inspection} last week.
translation: Ресторан прошёл санитарную проверку на прошлой неделе.

definition: a story that people repeat but that may not be true
sentence: There is a {rumor} that the factory will close.
translation: Ходят слухи, что завод закроют.

definition: not supporting either side in an argument or war
sentence: Switzerland stayed {neutral} during both world wars.
translation: Швейцария оставалась нейтральной в обе мировые войны.

definition: the father of your mother or father
sentence: My {grandfather} taught me how to fish.
translation: Мой дедушка научил меня ловить рыбу.

definition: a curved line, like part of a circle
sentence: The ball flew in a high {arc} over the fence.
translation: Мяч пролетел по высокой дуге над забором.

definition: a quick, simple drawing, or a short funny scene
sentence: The artist made a quick {sketch} of the church.
translation: Художник сделал быстрый набросок церкви.

definition: an event that shocks people because it is wrong or dishonest
sentence: The minister resigned after the {scandal} about his expenses.
translation: Министр ушёл в отставку после скандала с его расходами.

definition: a structure that birds build to lay their eggs in
sentence: A bird built a {nest} in the tree outside my window.
translation: Птица свила гнездо на дереве за моим окном.

definition: to have a different opinion from someone
sentence: I {disagree} with you about the best way to get there.
translation: Я не согласен с тобой насчёт лучшего пути туда.

definition: a box, bottle or other object used for holding things
sentence: Keep the rice in a closed {container}.
translation: Храни рис в закрытом контейнере.

definition: to use someone unfairly for your own benefit
sentence: That company {exploits} students by paying them almost nothing.
translation: Эта компания пользуется студентами, платя им почти ничего.

definition: the top inside surface of a room
sentence: There is a crack in the {ceiling} above the bed.
translation: В потолке над кроватью трещина.

definition: a toy that looks like a small person or baby
sentence: The girl took her {doll} everywhere she went.
translation: Девочка брала куклу с собой повсюду.

definition: happening or done one after another in a series
sentence: The police are hunting a {serial} thief who robs the same shops.
translation: Полиция ищет серийного вора, который грабит одни и те же магазины.

definition: to eat dinner, especially in a formal way
sentence: We will {dine} at the hotel restaurant tonight.
translation: Сегодня вечером мы поужинаем в ресторане отеля.

definition: to move a spoon around in a liquid to mix it
sentence: {Stir} the soup so it does not stick to the pan.
translation: Помешивай суп, чтобы он не пригорел.

definition: a statement about what you think will happen in the future
sentence: His {prediction} that it would rain was right.
translation: Его предсказание, что пойдёт дождь, сбылось.

definition: a man who rides a horse and looks after cattle in the American West
sentence: The {cowboy} rode across the desert for three days.
translation: Ковбой три дня ехал верхом через пустыню.

definition: the taste of a food or drink
sentence: This ice cream comes in a chocolate {flavor}.
translation: Это мороженое бывает со вкусом шоколада.

definition: large in amount, size or importance
sentence: We spent a {considerable} amount on the wedding.
translation: Мы потратили на свадьбу немалую сумму.

definition: following the usual or traditional way of doing things
sentence: She chose a {conventional} white dress for the wedding.
translation: Она выбрала традиционное белое платье для свадьбы.

definition: extremely large
sentence: An {enormous} tree fell across the road in the storm.
translation: Во время бури огромное дерево упало поперёк дороги.

definition: unhappy because you are alone and have no friends
sentence: She felt {lonely} in the big city at first.
translation: В большом городе она поначалу чувствовала себя одиноко.

definition: kindness shown to someone you could punish or hurt
sentence: The judge showed {mercy} and let the young man go.
translation: Судья проявил милосердие и отпустил молодого человека.

definition: in spite of that; however
sentence: It was raining; {nevertheless}, we went for a walk.
translation: Шёл дождь, тем не менее мы пошли гулять.

definition: on the outside, or far from the center
sentence: The {outer} wall of the castle is three meters thick.
translation: Внешняя стена замка толщиной три метра.

definition: a gas in the air that people and animals need to breathe
sentence: Climbers carry {oxygen} on the highest mountains.
translation: Альпинисты берут с собой кислород на самые высокие горы.

definition: the belief that some races are better than others, or unfair treatment because of race
sentence: The club was fined for {racism} among its fans.
translation: Клуб оштрафовали за расизм среди болельщиков.

definition: not polite; likely to upset people
sentence: It is {rude} to talk with your mouth full.
translation: Невежливо разговаривать с набитым ртом.

definition: to hit someone with the flat part of your hand
sentence: She wanted to {slap} him for the cruel joke.
translation: Ей хотелось дать ему пощёчину за жестокую шутку.

definition: to make a serious public promise
sentence: The company {pledged} to plant a tree for every order.
translation: Компания пообещала сажать дерево за каждый заказ.

definition: to officially say that something is not allowed
sentence: Smoking is {prohibited} anywhere near the playground.
translation: Курить рядом с детской площадкой запрещено.

definition: a group of signs and symptoms that show a particular illness or condition
sentence: The child was born with a rare {syndrome}.
translation: Ребёнок родился с редким синдромом.

definition: a person who moves to music, especially as a job
sentence: The {dancer} practiced the same step for hours.
translation: Танцовщица часами отрабатывала одно и то же движение.

definition: a person who starts a business and takes financial risks
sentence: The young {entrepreneur} opened three cafes in two years.
translation: Молодой предприниматель открыл три кафе за два года.

definition: a public procession of people, often with music, to celebrate something
sentence: The town holds a {parade} every year on the first of May.
translation: Город устраивает парад каждый год первого мая.

definition: to face a difficult person or problem instead of avoiding it
sentence: I finally {confronted} my neighbour about the loud music.
translation: Я наконец поговорил с соседом насчёт громкой музыки.

definition: a long thin straight piece of metal or wood
sentence: He fixed the curtain to a metal {rod} above the window.
translation: Он закрепил штору на металлическом стержне над окном.

definition: the ability to form pictures and ideas in your mind
sentence: Children have a rich {imagination} and invent whole worlds.
translation: У детей богатое воображение, они придумывают целые миры.

definition: to give official permission for something
sentence: Only the manager can {authorize} a refund.
translation: Только менеджер может разрешить возврат денег.
