definition: using power dishonestly for money or personal gain
sentence: The {corrupt} official took money to sign the papers.
translation: Коррумпированный чиновник брал деньги за подписание бумаг.

definition: a story or idea that many people believe but that is not true
sentence: It's a {myth} that cold weather gives you a cold.
translation: Это миф, что от холодной погоды можно простудиться.

definition: a person whose job is to study data and give advice about it
sentence: The {analyst} predicted that prices would fall next year.
translation: Аналитик предсказал, что цены упадут в следующем году.

definition: a copy of computer data kept in case the original is lost, or extra help
sentence: Make a {backup} of your photos before you fix the computer.
translation: Сделай резервную копию фотографий, прежде чем чинить компьютер.

definition: an amount that is more than needed or allowed
sentence: Wipe off the {excess} of paint with a cloth.
translation: Сотри излишек краски тряпкой.

definition: to force someone to do something
sentence: The law can {compel} witnesses to appear in court.
translation: Закон может принудить свидетелей явиться в суд.

definition: to check that something is true or correct
sentence: The bank will call to {verify} your address.
translation: Банк позвонит, чтобы подтвердить ваш адрес.

definition: a funny drawing in a newspaper, or a film made with drawings
sentence: The children watched a {cartoon} about a talking dog.
translation: Дети смотрели мультфильм о говорящей собаке.

definition: a march or meeting to protest, or an act of showing how something works
sentence: Thousands joined the {demonstration} against the war.
translation: Тысячи присоединились к демонстрации против войны.

definition: to respect and like someone for what they do
sentence: I really {admire} how calm she stays under pressure.
translation: Я правда восхищаюсь тем, как спокойно она держится под давлением.

definition: thick soft material that covers the floor of a room
sentence: The cat scratched a hole in the new {carpet}.
translation: Кошка процарапала дыру в новом ковре.

definition: a flat round object, such as one that stores music or data
sentence: The old music was kept on a {disc} in the attic.
translation: Старая музыка хранилась на диске на чердаке.

definition: one of several levels or rows placed one above another
sentence: The cake had three tiers, and the top {tier} was for the couple.
translation: У торта было три яруса, и верхний ярус предназначался для пары.

definition: the size of one part compared with the whole
sentence: A large {proportion} of my salary goes on rent.
translation: Большая часть моей зарплаты уходит на аренду.

definition: an atom that has an electric charge
sentence: Salt in water breaks into a positive and a negative {ion}.
translation: Соль в воде распадается на положительный и отрицательный ион.

definition: films made from drawings or models that appear to move
sentence: The studio is famous for its {animation} of talking animals.
translation: Студия известна своей анимацией с говорящими животными.

definition: a building where people play games for money
sentence: He lost a lot of money at the {casino} in one night.
translation: Он проиграл много денег в казино за одну ночь.

definition: a device that opens and closes to control the flow of liquid or gas
sentence: Turn the {valve} to stop the water.
translation: Поверни вентиль, чтобы перекрыть воду.

definition: the quality of being exact and correct
sentence: The map is drawn with great {accuracy}.
translation: Карта нарисована с большой точностью.

definition: made by people rather than existing naturally
sentence: The park has an {artificial} lake with a fountain.
translation: В парке искусственное озеро с фонтаном.

definition: under; in a lower position than
sentence: The cat was hiding {beneath} the bed.
translation: Кошка пряталась под кроватью.

definition: always in the same way or at the same level
sentence: She has {consistently} scored the best marks in the class.
translation: Она стабильно получает лучшие оценки в классе.

definition: earth or soil, or anything that makes something not clean
sentence: The children came home covered in {dirt}.
translation: Дети вернулись домой все в грязи.

definition: including many different types of people or things
sentence: The city has a {diverse} population from all over the world.
translation: Население города разнообразно и съехалось со всего мира.

definition: relating to God or a god
sentence: The king believed he ruled by {divine} right.
translation: Король верил, что правит по божественному праву.

definition: only; limited to one person, group or thing
sentence: The pool is {exclusively} for hotel guests.
translation: Бассейн только для гостей отеля.

definition: in the past; before now
sentence: The museum was {formerly} a railway station.
translation: Музей раньше был железнодорожным вокзалом.

definition: designed to be useful rather than attractive, or working correctly
sentence: The kitchen is small but {functional}.
translation: Кухня маленькая, но функциональная.

definition: unhappy because someone has something you want, or afraid of losing someone's love
sentence: He gets {jealous} when she talks to other men.
translation: Он ревнует, когда она разговаривает с другими мужчинами.

definition: not willing to work or make an effort
sentence: My {lazy} brother sleeps until noon every day.
translation: Мой ленивый брат каждый день спит до полудня.

definition: relating to a town or city and its local government
sentence: The {municipal} swimming pool is free for children.
translation: Городской бассейн бесплатен для детей.

definition: relating to a navy or to warships
sentence: The {naval} base is home to twenty ships.
translation: На военно-морской базе базируются двадцать кораблей.

definition: the state of being liked by many people
sentence: The singer's {popularity} grew after the TV show.
translation: Популярность певицы выросла после телешоу.

definition: connected with God or religion, and treated with great respect
sentence: The temple is a {sacred} place; please remove your shoes.
translation: Храм — священное место, пожалуйста, снимите обувь.

definition: the use of violence against ordinary people to achieve political aims
sentence: The city increased security because of the threat of {terrorism}.
translation: Город усилил безопасность из-за угрозы терроризма.

definition: able to make people ill or kill them, like poison
sentence: The factory released {toxic} smoke into the air.
translation: Завод выбрасывал в воздух ядовитый дым.

definition: the government department that controls a country's money
sentence: The {treasury} warned that taxes might rise next year.
translation: Казначейство предупредило, что налоги могут вырасти в следующем году.

definition: to make a process easier or faster
sentence: The new app {facilitates} booking a table in seconds.
translation: Новое приложение позволяет забронировать столик за секунды.

definition: a box made of bars or wire for keeping birds or animals in
sentence: The parrot sat quietly in its {cage}.
translation: Попугай тихо сидел в своей клетке.

definition: to pass a disease to a person, animal or plant
sentence: One sick child can {infect} the whole class.
translation: Один больной ребёнок может заразить весь класс.

definition: a spoken description of an event as it happens, or a set of explanations
sentence: We listened to the radio {commentary} on the match.
translation: Мы слушали радиорепортаж о матче.

definition: to order someone not to do something
sentence: My parents {forbade} me to ride a motorbike.
translation: Родители запретили мне ездить на мотоцикле.

definition: advice, or a lawyer who speaks for someone in court
sentence: She asked her father for {counsel} before deciding.
translation: Она попросила у отца совета, прежде чем решить.

definition: a small round white jewel that forms inside some shellfish
sentence: She wore a single {pearl} on a gold chain.
translation: На ней была одна жемчужина на золотой цепочке.

definition: a person who teaches people or animals skills, or a sports shoe
sentence: The {trainer} made the team run ten laps.
translation: Тренер заставил команду пробежать десять кругов.

definition: a person who believes women should have the same rights as men
sentence: As a {feminist}, she fights for equal pay.
translation: Как феминистка, она борется за равную оплату.

definition: the brown color of skin after time in the sun
sentence: She came back from Greece with a deep {tan}.
translation: Она вернулась из Греции с густым загаром.

definition: to build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed
sentence: It took ten years to {rebuild} the city after the war.
translation: На восстановление города после войны ушло десять лет.

definition: to wait for something
sentence: Thousands of fans {await} the band's new album.
translation: Тысячи фанатов ждут новый альбом группы.

definition: to make pain or a problem less serious
sentence: This cream will {relieve} the pain of the burn.
translation: Этот крем снимет боль от ожога.

definition: an older person, especially one respected in a community
sentence: The village {elder} settled the argument between the two farmers.
translation: Старейшина деревни разрешил спор между двумя фермерами.

definition: one of the nine parts of a baseball game
sentence: We left in the seventh {inning} because it was freezing.
translation: Мы ушли в седьмом иннинге, потому что замёрзли.

definition: the act of finishing something
sentence: The {completion} of the bridge is planned for June.
translation: Завершение моста запланировано на июнь.

definition: a long piece of cloth or paper with words on it, carried or hung up
sentence: The fans held up a {banner} with the player's name.
translation: Болельщики подняли баннер с именем игрока.

definition: a high steep rock face, especially by the sea
sentence: The path runs along the top of the {cliff}.
translation: Тропа идёт по краю утёса.

definition: a person who sells something
sentence: The {seller} agreed to lower the price of the car.
translation: Продавец согласился снизить цену на машину.

definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal, usually because of illness
sentence: The child has a {fever} and should stay in bed.
translation: У ребёнка жар, и ему нужно оставаться в постели.

definition: a recorded program that you can download and listen to
sentence: I listen to a history {podcast} on my way to work.
translation: По дороге на работу я слушаю подкаст по истории.

definition: something good that you are grateful for, or a prayer asking for God's help
sentence: Good health is a {blessing} that many people forget.
translation: Крепкое здоровье — благо, о котором многие забывают.

definition: one of the first people to do something new or go to a new place
sentence: She was a {pioneer} of modern dance in the 1920s.
translation: Она была первопроходцем современного танца в 1920-е.

definition: an idea or statement that an argument or story is based on
sentence: The film's {premise} is that animals can talk to children.
translation: В основе фильма идея, что животные умеют говорить с детьми.

definition: to throw something lightly and carelessly
sentence: {Toss} the salad with a little oil and salt.
translation: Перемешай салат с небольшим количеством масла и соли.

definition: a place in a port where ships are loaded, unloaded or repaired
sentence: The ship stayed in the {dock} for a week of repairs.
translation: Корабль неделю стоял в доке на ремонте.

definition: to form or make up something
sentence: Women {constitute} more than half of the workforce.
translation: Женщины составляют более половины рабочей силы.

definition: to mix two or more things together so that they become one
sentence: {Blend} the fruit with yogurt for a quick breakfast.
translation: Смешай фрукты с йогуртом для быстрого завтрака.

definition: a small round red fruit with a stone in the middle
sentence: She put a {cherry} on top of each cake.
translation: Она положила по вишенке на каждое пирожное.

definition: a flat round piece of cooked meat eaten in a bread roll
sentence: I ordered a {burger} with fries and a cola.
translation: Я заказал бургер с картошкой фри и колой.

definition: in a way that involves doing things rather than waiting
sentence: The police are {actively} looking for the missing boy.
translation: Полиция активно ищет пропавшего мальчика.

definition: relaxed and not formal, or not planned or regular
sentence: Wear {casual} clothes; it is only a picnic.
translation: Надень что-нибудь повседневное, это всего лишь пикник.

definition: causing a lot of disagreement because many people have strong opinions
sentence: The new road is a {controversial} plan in the village.
translation: Новая дорога — спорный план для деревни.
